sources.title: OpenTelemetry: handling sensitive data
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: STIX 2.1：指標有效期、撤銷與來源信心
related.titleEn: STIX 2.1: indicator validity, revocation and provenance
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付資料流、200欄位測試、所有輸出差異及必要觀測欄位保留證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the dataflow, two-hundred-field tests, exporter diffs and evidence that essential observability fields survive.
related.difference: 區分created、modified、valid_from、valid_until、revoked與confidence；記錄自己的使用政策而不混成一個時間。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish created, modified, valid_from, valid_until, revoked and confidence, documenting local use policy separately.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 移除完整率=已正確移除的敏感欄位/所有標記敏感欄位；還要另測必要追蹤欄位是否保留。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 100筆合成事件各含2個敏感欄位，共200個；目前正確移除190個。 完整率190/200=95%，仍殘留10個假敏感欄位。
可用集合=在有效時窗內且未撤銷且來源政策允許的指標；新近修改不會自動延長有效期。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 100個合成指標中70個在有效期內，這70個中5個已撤銷、另5個來源不符本地政策。 可用70−5−5=60個，即60%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Redaction completeness is correctly removed sensitive fields over all labeled sensitive fields; separately verify useful trace fields remain. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. One hundred synthetic events each contain two sensitive fields, totaling two hundred; 190 are correctly removed. Completeness=190/200=95%, leaving ten fake sensitive fields.

Usable indicators must be in their validity window, not revoked, and allowed by source policy; modification time does not automatically extend validity. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Of one hundred synthetic indicators, seventy are within validity; five of those are revoked and another five fail local source policy. Usable count=70−5−5=60, or 60%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 勒索事件桌上演練：隔離、乾淨復原與相依順序
related.titleEn: Ransomware tabletop: isolation, clean recovery and dependencies
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付資料流、200欄位測試、所有輸出差異及必要觀測欄位保留證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the dataflow, two-hundred-field tests, exporter diffs and evidence that essential observability fields survive.
related.difference: 將身分服務、資料庫、應用與備份驗證畫成相依圖，先確認乾淨復原環境與必要存取。
related.differenceEn: Map identity, database, application and backup-validation dependencies, confirming a clean recovery environment and required access.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 移除完整率=已正確移除的敏感欄位/所有標記敏感欄位；還要另測必要追蹤欄位是否保留。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 100筆合成事件各含2個敏感欄位，共200個；目前正確移除190個。 完整率190/200=95%，仍殘留10個假敏感欄位。
復原完工時間由相依關係的關鍵路徑決定，不是所有工時任意相加或取最大。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 身分復原30分鐘，之後資料庫40分鐘，再啟動應用25分鐘；備份驗證20分鐘可與身分復原平行。 關鍵路徑30+40+25=95分鐘；平行的20分鐘驗證不額外延長。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Redaction completeness is correctly removed sensitive fields over all labeled sensitive fields; separately verify useful trace fields remain. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. One hundred synthetic events each contain two sensitive fields, totaling two hundred; 190 are correctly removed. Completeness=190/200=95%, leaving ten fake sensitive fields.

Recovery completion follows the dependency critical path, not an arbitrary sum or maximum of task times. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Identity recovery takes thirty minutes, then database forty, then application twenty-five; twenty-minute backup validation runs in parallel with identity. The critical path is 30+40+25=95 minutes; parallel twenty-minute validation adds no further delay.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
